en.t: Claudius formally invested with imperial powers
en.s: On 25 January AD 41, Claudius was formally invested with the powers of the Roman emperor after the Senate’s resistance collapsed. This was distinct from his protection and acclamation by the Praetorian Guard following Caligula’s assassination on January 24. The events took place in Rome, in present-day Italy.

zh.t: 克劳狄乌斯正式获授皇帝权力
zh.s: 公元41年1月25日，元老院的抵抗瓦解后，克劳狄乌斯正式获授罗马皇帝的权力。这与前一天卡利古拉遇刺后，他受到禁卫军保护和拥立是不同阶段。事件发生在罗马，地点位于今意大利境内。

en.s: The Battle of the Zab (Arabic: معركة الزاب), also referred to in scholarly contexts as Battle of the Great Zāb River, took place on January 25, 750, on the banks of the Great Zab in what is now the modern country of Iraq. It spelled the end of the Umayyad Caliphate and the rise of the Abbasid Caliphate, which would last from 750 to 1258.

zh.s: 扎卜河战役（阿拉伯语：معركة الزاب），学术文献中也称大扎卜河战役，于750年1月25日在今伊拉克境内的大扎卜河畔爆发。此战终结了倭马亚哈里发国，并促成阿拔斯哈里发国兴起；后者延续至1258年。

en.t: Edward III proclaimed king of England
en.s: On 25 January 1327, Edward III was proclaimed king of England in London, in present-day United Kingdom, following his father Edward II’s deposition. His coronation at Westminster Abbey took place on February 1.

zh.t: 爱德华三世被宣布为英格兰国王
zh.s: 1327年1月25日，爱德华二世被废黜后，爱德华三世在伦敦被宣布为英格兰国王。伦敦位于今英国境内。他于2月1日在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕。

en.t: A strong earthquake strikes the South Alpine region of Friuli in modern Italy, causing considerable damage to buildings as far away as Rome
en.s: The 1348 Friuli earthquake, centered in the South Alpine region of Friuli, was felt across Europe on 25 January. The earthquake hit in the same year that the Great Plague ravaged Italy. According to contemporary sources, it caused considerable damage to structures; churches and houses collapsed and villages were destroyed.

zh.s: 1348年1月25日，震中位于意大利现今南阿尔卑斯地区弗留利的地震波及欧洲各地。当年意大利正遭受大瘟疫侵袭。据当时资料，地震造成严重建筑损毁，教堂和房屋倒塌，村庄被毁。

en.s: The Treaty of Constantinople was signed on 25 January 1479, which officially ended the sixteen-year-long war between the Republic of Venice and the Ottoman Empire. The Venetians were forced to hand over Scutari (which had been besieged by the Ottomans for many months) in Albania and the island of Lemnos and the Mani Peninsula in Greece; and acknowledge the loss of Negroponte (Euboea) and Croia.

zh.s: 《君士坦丁堡条约》于1479年1月25日签署，正式结束了威尼斯共和国与奥斯曼帝国长达16年的战争。威尼斯被迫交出阿尔巴尼亚的斯库台（该城已被奥斯曼军队围困数月）、希腊的利姆诺斯岛和马尼半岛，并承认失去内格罗蓬特（优卑亚岛）和克罗亚。

en.s: The First Ottoman–Venetian War was fought between the Republic of Venice with its allies and the Ottoman Empire from 1463 to 1479. Fought shortly after the capture of Constantinople and the remnants of the Byzantine Empire by the Ottomans, it resulted in the loss of several Venetian holdings in Albania and Greece, most importantly the island of Negroponte (Euboea), which had been a Venetian protectorate for centuries.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第一次奥斯曼—威尼斯战争发生于1463年至1479年，交战双方为威尼斯共和国及其盟友与奥斯曼帝国。战争发生在奥斯曼人攻占君士坦丁堡及拜占庭帝国残余领土后不久，结果是威尼斯失去在阿尔巴尼亚和希腊的数处据点，其中最重要的是内格罗蓬特岛（优卑亚岛）；该岛此前数百年一直是威尼斯的保护领地。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Alfonso II becomes King of Naples
en.s: Alfonso II (4 November 1448 – 18 December 1495) was Duke of Calabria and ruled as King of Naples from 25 January 1494 to 23 January 1495. He was a soldier and a patron of Renaissance architecture and the arts. Heir to his father Ferdinand I's Kingdom of Naples, Alfonso held the dukedom of Calabria for most of his life.

zh.t: 阿方索二世成为那不勒斯国王
zh.s: 阿方索二世（1448年11月4日—1495年12月18日）曾任卡拉布里亚公爵，并于1494年1月25日至1495年1月23日担任那不勒斯国王。他是一名军人，也是文艺复兴时期建筑和艺术的赞助人。作为其父费兰特一世的那不勒斯王国继承人，阿方索大半生都担任卡拉布里亚公爵。

en.s: On 25 January 1515, Francis I was crowned king of France at Reims Cathedral.

zh.t: 弗朗索瓦一世在兰斯加冕
zh.s: 1515年1月25日，弗朗索瓦一世在兰斯主教座堂加冕为法国国王。

en.t: Jesuit college founded at São Paulo de Piratininga
en.s: On 25 January 1554, Jesuit priests founded the Colégio de São Paulo de Piratininga in what is now São Paulo, Brazil. The city traces its founding date to the college, which was established to evangelize Indigenous people.

zh.t: 圣保罗德皮拉蒂宁加学院成立
zh.s: 1554年1月25日，耶稣会神父在今巴西圣保罗建立圣保罗德皮拉蒂宁加学院，向原住民传教。圣保罗市以学院成立的这一天作为建城日。

en.s: The Battle of Mikatagahara (三方ヶ原の戦い Mikatagahara no tatakai) (January 25, 1573; Tōtōmi Province, Japan) was one of the most famous battles of Takeda Shingen's campaigns, and one of the best demonstrations of his cavalry-based tactics. It was also one of Tokugawa Ieyasu's worst defeats, and complete disaster was only narrowly averted. According to the Japanese calendar, the battle was fought on the 22nd day, 12th month, the year Genki-3.

zh.s: 1573年1月25日，即日本元龟三年十二月二十二日，远江国爆发三方原之战。这是武田信玄征战中最著名的战役之一，充分展现其以骑兵为核心的战术。它也是德川家康最惨重的败战之一，家康仅勉强避免了彻底覆灭。

en.s: The Battle of Nantwich was fought during the First English Civil War, between the Parliamentarians and Royalists, northwest of the town of Nantwich in Cheshire on 25 January 1644. The Royalists under Lord Byron were besieging Nantwich, and Sir Thomas Fairfax led an army to relieve the town. As Fairfax approached, a sudden thaw caused the River Weaver to rise in spate, dividing Byron's cavalry from his infantry and artillery, who were overrun and destroyed by Fairfax. The Parliamentarian victory halted a run of Royalist successes in the area, and was a major setback to King Charles I's plan of campaign for the year.

zh.s: 1644年1月25日，第一次英国内战中的南特威奇战役，在柴郡该镇西北展开。拜伦勋爵率保王军围城，托马斯·费尔法克斯爵士率议会军前来解围。费尔法克斯接近时，天气突然转暖，韦弗河水暴涨，将拜伦的骑兵与步兵、炮兵隔开，后两者被议会军击溃。议会派获胜，终止了保王派在当地连续得胜的局面，也重挫查理一世当年的作战计划。

en.t: Francisco Gómez de la Rocha executed in Potosí
en.s: On 25 January 1650, Francisco Gómez de la Rocha was executed by garrote in Potosí, in present-day Bolivia, following the mint-fraud investigation. His body was publicly displayed in the main square the next day.

zh.t: 弗朗西斯科·戈麦斯·德拉罗查在波托西被处决
zh.s: 1650年1月25日，造币厂舞弊案调查后，弗朗西斯科·戈麦斯·德拉罗查在波托西被处以绞刑，遗体于次日在主广场示众。波托西位于今玻利维亚境内。

en.s: The Apalachee massacre was a series of raids by English colonists from the Province of Carolina and their Muscogee allies against a largely peaceful Apalachee population in northern Spanish Florida which took place in January 1704 during Queen Anne's War. Against limited Spanish and Apalachee resistance, a network of Catholic missions was destroyed by the raiders; most of their population were either killed, captured, fled to larger Spanish and French outposts, or voluntarily joined the English.
en.n: The Apalachee massacre: A combined British and Muscogee force from the Province of Carolina destroys the main fortified mission of Ayubale, breaking Spain's hold on Spanish Florida.

zh.s: 1704年1月，安妮女王战争期间，卡罗来纳省的英国殖民者与其穆斯科吉盟友多次袭击西属佛罗里达北部相对和平的阿帕拉契人。西班牙和阿帕拉契人的抵抗有限，袭击者摧毁了当地的天主教传教站网络；当地居民大多被杀或俘虏，也有人逃往较大的西班牙或法国据点，或自愿加入英国人。
zh.n: 阿帕拉契惨案：卡罗来纳省的英军与穆斯科吉人联军摧毁阿尤巴莱的主要防御传教站，打破西班牙对西属佛罗里达的控制。

en.s: During the night of 25 January 1780, British forces staged simultaneous raids into Elizabethtown and Newark in New Jersey.

zh.t: 英军突袭伊丽莎白镇与纽瓦克
zh.s: 1780年1月25日夜，英国军队同时突袭新泽西州伊丽莎白镇与纽瓦克。

en.t: London Corresponding Society holds its first meeting
en.s: On 25 January 1792, Thomas Hardy and seven friends held the first meeting of the London Corresponding Society in London, United Kingdom. The society campaigned for democratic parliamentary reform.

zh.t: 伦敦通讯协会举行首次会议
zh.s: 1792年1月25日，托马斯·哈迪与七名朋友在英国伦敦举行伦敦通讯协会首次会议。该协会致力于推动议会民主改革。

en.s: The Action of 25 January 1797 was a minor naval battle of the French Revolutionary Wars, fought in the Gulf of Cádiz. The Spanish third-rate ship of the line San Francisco de Asís was attacked and pursued for several hours by a British squadron of three fifth-rates frigates and a sixth-rate corvette under George Stewart, 8th Earl of Galloway. After an intermittent but fierce exchange of fire, the British warships, badly damaged, were eventually forced to withdraw. The San Francisco de Asís, which suffered only minor damage, was able to return to Cádiz without difficulties.

zh.s: 1797年1月25日，法国革命战争中的一场小规模海战在加的斯湾展开。西班牙三级战列舰“圣弗朗西斯科德阿西斯”号，遭到第八代加洛韦伯爵乔治·斯图尔特指挥的英国舰队攻击追逐数小时，英方由三艘五级护卫舰和一艘六级轻型军舰组成。双方间歇但激烈交火后，英舰严重受损，被迫撤退。西舰只有轻微损坏，顺利返回加的斯。

en.s: On 25 January 1800, Republican troops defeated Chouan forces at the Tombettes, between Le Châtellier and Parigné in France, during the Chouannerie.

zh.s: 1800年1月25日，法国共和军在勒沙特利耶与帕里涅之间的通贝特击败舒昂军。这是舒昂党叛乱中的一场战斗。

en.s: In the Battle of Mohrungen on 25 January 1807, most of a First French Empire corps under the leadership of Marshal Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte fought a strong Russian Empire advance guard led by Major General Yevgeni Ivanovich Markov. The French pushed back the main Russian force, but a cavalry raid on the French supply train caused Bernadotte to call off his attacks. After driving off the cavalry, Bernadotte withdrew and the town was occupied by the army of General Levin August, Count von Bennigsen. The fighting took place in and around Morąg in northern Poland, which in 1807 was the East Prussian town of Mohrungen.

zh.s: 1807年1月25日，让-巴蒂斯特·贝尔纳多特元帅率领法国第一帝国一个军团的大部分兵力，与叶夫根尼·伊万诺维奇·马尔科夫少将指挥的俄国强大先遣队交战。法军击退俄军主力，但俄国骑兵突袭法军辎重队，迫使贝尔纳多特停止攻击。赶走骑兵后，他撤退，当地城镇被列文·奥古斯特·冯·本尼格森伯爵将军的军队占领。战斗发生于今波兰北部莫龙格及周边，当时称东普鲁士莫龙根。

en.s: A UK parliamentary by-election was held for one of the two seats in Birmingham on 23–25 January 1840. The Radical candidate George Muntz was returned, ahead of Conservative Charles Wetherell.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1840年1月23日至25日，英国伯明翰两个议席中的一个举行议会补选。激进派候选人乔治·蒙茨当选，领先于保守党候选人查尔斯·韦瑟雷尔。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Cegléd was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849, fought on 25 January 1849 between the revolutionary Hungarian army led by General Mór Perczel against the cavalry brigade of the Austrian Empire led by General Ferenc Ottinger. After the First Battle of Szolnok Ottinger retreated to Cegléd and received some infantry reinforcements to his cavalry brigade.

zh.s: 切格莱德战役是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争中的一场战斗，于1849年1月25日爆发。匈牙利革命军由莫尔·佩尔采尔将军率领，对阵奥地利帝国费伦茨·奥廷格将军指挥的骑兵旅。索尔诺克首战后，奥廷格撤至切格莱德，并为骑兵旅增派了一些步兵。

en.s: The siege of Longwy was a military conflict during the Franco-Prussian War, which took place from 16 to 25 January 1871, in the Longwy which was near the border of Belgium and Luxembourg. (Under a Personal Union with the Netherlands) After the artillery fire from the Prussian army, the siege ended with the defenders of Longwy under the command of Colonel Massaroly surrendering to Prussia under the command of Colonel Von Cosel.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 朗维围城战是普法战争期间的一场军事冲突，发生于1871年1月16日至25日。朗维位于比利时和卢森堡边境附近（当时卢森堡与荷兰处于共主邦联关系）。普鲁士军队炮击后，朗维守军在马萨罗利上校指挥下向冯·科塞尔上校率领的普鲁士军队投降，围城战随之结束。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On 25 January 1879, Prince Alexander Dondukov-Korsakov, the Russian imperial commissioner in Bulgaria, approved the charter of the Bulgarian National Bank. This was the charter’s approval, rather than the bank’s later opening for business.

zh.t: 保加利亚国家银行章程获批
zh.s: 1879年1月25日，俄罗斯驻保加利亚帝国专员亚历山大·顿杜科夫-科尔萨科夫亲王批准保加利亚国家银行章程。本条记录的是章程获批，并非银行后来正式营业的日期。

en.t: Thomas Edison and Alexander Graham Bell form the Oriental Telephone Company
en.s: The Oriental Telephone Company was established on January 25, 1881, as the result of an agreement between Thomas Edison, Alexander Graham Bell, the Oriental Bell Telephone Company of New York and the Anglo-Indian Telephone Company, Ltd. The company was licensed to sell telephones in Greece, Turkey, South Africa, India, Japan, China, and other Asian countries.

zh.t: 托马斯·爱迪生和亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔成立东方电话公司
zh.s: 东方电话公司于1881年1月25日成立，源于托马斯·爱迪生、亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔、纽约东方贝尔电话公司和英印电话有限公司达成的一项协议。公司获准在希腊、土耳其、南非、印度、日本、中国及其他亚洲国家销售电话。

en.s: On January 25, 1887, Italian colonial troops repelled an Ethiopian attack at Saati, in present-day Eritrea. It was the first battle of the Italo-Ethiopian War of 1887–1889.

zh.s: 1887年1月25日，意大利殖民军在萨阿蒂击退埃塞俄比亚军队的进攻。萨阿蒂位于今厄立特里亚境内，这一战是1887年至1889年意埃战争的首场战斗。

en.t: The Arrival of a Train at La Ciotat released
en.s: The retained film infobox dates the release of the Lumière brothers’ The Arrival of a Train at La Ciotat to 25 January 1896. Its narrative places the first public showing in Lyon, France, in January 1896 and distinguishes it from the Paris screening of December 28, 1895.
en.n: The precise day follows the retained film infobox; its narrative gives January 1896 for the first Lyon showing.

zh.s: 来源的电影资料框将卢米埃尔兄弟《火车进站》的上映日期列为1896年1月25日。正文记载，影片于1896年1月在法国里昂首次公开放映，并未出现在1895年12月28日巴黎首映的片单中。
zh.n: 具体日期采用来源电影资料框；正文仅将里昂首次放映记为1896年1月。

en.t: Louis E. McComas elected to the US Senate
en.s: On January 25, 1898, Maryland’s legislature elected Republican Louis E. McComas to the United States Senate, replacing Democrat Arthur P. Gorman. At the time, state legislatures elected US senators.

zh.t: 路易斯·麦科马斯当选美国参议员
zh.s: 1898年1月25日，马里兰州议会选出共和党人路易斯·麦科马斯担任美国参议员，接替民主党人阿瑟·戈尔曼。当时，美国参议员由各州议会选举产生。

en.t: 1899 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1899 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 44th Wisconsin Legislature between January 25, 1899, and January 31, 1899. Incumbent Democratic U.S. senator John L. Mitchell did not run for a second term. Republican lawyer and former state legislator Joseph V. Quarles was elected to succeed him on the sixth ballot.

zh.t: 1899年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1899年1月25日至31日，威斯康星州第四十四届议会举行联邦参议员选举。民主党籍现任约翰·L.米切尔不再竞选第二任期，共和党律师、前州议员约瑟夫·V.夸尔斯在第六轮投票当选接替他。

en.s: The Battle of Middelfontein was a Boer War battle fought from 22 to 25 January 1901, near Rustenburg in the Northern Transvaal region. A column of British forces under General Cunningham were marching to Vlakfontein to cut off Boer forces under De la Rey when they were attacked by commandos near Middelfontein farm. The battle was small but significant, as it was the first battle fought under the reign of the new King Edward VII.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 米德尔方丹战役是第二次布尔战争期间的一场战斗，于1901年1月22日至25日在德兰士瓦北部地区鲁斯滕堡附近发生。坎宁安将军率领一支英军纵队前往弗拉克方丹，准备切断德拉雷率领的布尔军队，却在米德尔方丹农场附近遭到突击队袭击。这场战斗规模不大，但意义重大，是新国王爱德华七世在位期间的首场战斗。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Ontario general election, 1905 was the 11th general election held in the Province of Ontario, Canada. It was held on January 25, 1905, to elect the 98 Members of the 11th Legislative Assembly of Ontario ("MLAs"). The Ontario Conservative Party, led by Sir James P. Whitney, defeated the Ontario Liberal Party, led by Sir George William Ross, bringing to an end the control of the government that the Liberal Party had exercised power for the previous 34 years.

zh.s: 1905年1月25日，加拿大安大略省举行第11次大选，改选第十一届省议会98席。詹姆斯·P.惠特尼爵士领导的安大略保守党，击败乔治·威廉·罗斯爵士领导的自由党，结束自由党长达34年的执政。

en.t: 1905 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1905 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 47th Wisconsin Legislature on January 25, 1905. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Joseph V. Quarles ran for a second term but lost re-nomination to the popular incumbent governor, Robert M. La Follette. After being elected U.S. senator, however, La Follette delayed taking office for an entire year, continuing to serve as governor through all of 1905.

zh.t: 1905年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举

en.s: The 1961 Salvadoran coup d'état was a successful countercoup in El Salvador led by Colonel Aníbal Portillo against the short-lived Junta of Government that had taken power in 1960, replacing the reformist military junta with an ardent anti-communist government named the Civic-Military Directory. By the end of that year, military governance had given way to democratic rule. Motives behind the military overthrow were reactionary in nature, driven by military fears of a Communist takeover within the country, due to the perceived sympathies of the reformist junta towards Communist and Cuban influence. These concerns were further exacerbated by the visit to Cuba by far-left Salvadoran extremists, spurring the disunited Armed Forces to unify in safeguarding the state from Communism. On 25 January 1961, the planned military coup, which had the backing of every top army official, was finally executed, ending in the successful deposing of the six-man civilian-military junta.

en.t: Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity landed on Mars and rolled into Eagle crater, a small crater on the Meridiani Planum
en.s: Opportunity, also known as MER-B (Mars Exploration Rover – B) or MER-1, and nicknamed Oppy, is a robotic rover that was active on Mars from 2004 until 2018. Opportunity was operational on Mars for 5111 sols (14 years, 138 days on Earth). Launched on July 7, 2003, as part of NASA's Mars Exploration Rover program, it landed in Meridiani Planum on January 25, 2004, three weeks after its twin, Spirit (MER-A), touched down on the other side of the planet.

en.s: The Battle of Mullaitivu was a land battle fought between the Sri Lankan Military and the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) for the control of the town of Mullaitivu in the Northern Theater of Eelam War IV during the Sri Lankan civil war. The town of Mullaitivu was the last stronghold of the LTTE. The government declared on 25 January 2009 that its troops had entered the town and were consolidating their positions. The Sri Lanka Air Force had been attacking LTTE positions in and around Mullaitivu for several days before the government troops claimed to have entered it.

en.t: January 2021 Tobago House of Assembly election
en.s: House of Assembly elections were held in Tobago on 25 January 2021 where 12 members were elected in the eleventh election since the Assembly was established in 1980. This election marked the first time in history that both parties elected, the People's National Movement (PNM) and Progressive Democratic Patriots (PDP) won an equal number seats of 6-6, despite the PNM winning the popular vote, resulting in a deadlock and a constitutional crisis with both political parties and Prime Minister Keith Rowley seeking senior counsel advice on the way forward.

zh.s: 2021年1月25日，多巴哥举行议会选举，选出12名议员，是1980年议会成立以来的第十一次选举。人民民族运动虽获得最多选票，却与进步民主爱国者各得六席，首次出现两党席位相等。这造成僵局及宪制危机，两党和总理基思·罗利都向资深法律顾问寻求后续办法。
